abstracts.content:
W artykule poddano analizie wpływ zastąpienia części cementu wypełniaczami mine-
ralnymi – mączką kwarcową i chalcedonitową – na skuteczność oczyszczania powietrza
z tlenków azotu przez zaprawy o właściwościach fotokatalitycznych. Badania przepro-
wadzono według autorskiej metodyki, odwzorowującej rzeczywiste warunki oświetlenia
oraz stężenia zanieczyszczeń. Zjawisko fotokatalizy było badane zarówno w świetle
UV o irradiancji 0,2 W/m2 (odpowiadające indeksowi UV = 8 występującym w Polsce)
oraz światłem widzialnym o irradiancji 150 W/m 2. Na podstawie badań stwierdzono, iż
zastępowanie części spoiwa wypełniaczami mineralnymi przyczynia się do znaczącego
spadku efektywności oczyszczania powietrza oraz spadku selektywności w utlenianiu
NOx
. Przeprowadzone badania potwierdziły również zasadność zwiększania zawartości
spoiwa w zaprawie w celu zwiększenia jej skuteczności w oczyszczaniu powietrza.

The article analyzes the effect of replacing part of the cement with mineral fillers - quartz
and chalcedonite powder - on the efficiency of air purification from nitrogen oxides by
mortars with photocatalytic properties. The study was conducted according to the author’s
methodology, reproducing actual lighting conditions and pollutant concentrations. The
photocatalysis phenomenon was studied under UV light with an irradiance of 0,2 W/m 2
(corresponding to the UV index = 8 found in Poland) and visible light with an irradiance
of 150 W/m2. Based on the study, it was concluded that replacing part of the binder with mineral fillers contributes to a significant decrease in air purification efficiency and a de-
crease in selectivity in NOx oxidation. The study also confirmed the validity of increasing
the binder content in the mortar to increase its efficiency in air purification.

results.title: Wielki kryzys i zabytki. Działalność Towarzystwa Opieki nad Zabytkami Przeszłości w zakresie inwentaryzacji architektoniczno-pomiarowej w latach 1933–1934 i jej znaczenie dla ochrony zabytków w II Rzeczypospolitej

abstracts.content: Celem niniejszego artykułu jest omówienie inwentaryzacji pomiarowej zabytków architektury prowadzonej przez Towarzystwo Opieki nad Zabytkami Przeszłości (TOnZP) w ramach subwencji Funduszu Pracy w latach 1933–1934. Akcję pomiarową ukazano w kontekście wielkiego kryzysu, który w całej Polsce spowodował niemal zupełne zamarcie ruchu budowlanego, a tym samym wyjątkowe bezrobocie wśród architektów, zwłaszcza młodego pokolenia. Fundusz Pracy miał pomagać w zwalczaniu bezrobocia poprzez inicjowanie prac publicznych, przy których zatrudnienie znaleźli pracownicy umysłowi (m.in. architekci i historycy sztuki). Co więcej, akcja TOnZP miała na celu kontynuowanie państwowej inwentaryzacji naukowej, w związku z czym była prowadzona w bezpośrednim porozumieniu z Centralnym Biurem Inwentaryzacji Zabytków Sztuki w Ministerstwie Wyznań Religijnych i Oświecenia Publicznego. W ramach prac zinwentaryzowano około stu zabytków architektury w kilku województwach (m.in. kieleckim, warszawskim, śląskim i krakowskim), a zbiór przeszło pięciuset zdjęć pomiarowych ostatecznie przekazano do archiwum Centralnego Biura Inwentaryzacji.

The aim of this article is to discuss the measurement inventorying of architectural monuments carried out by the Society for the Protection of Monuments of the Past within the framework of the Labour Fund subsidy in the years 1933–1934. The Society’s measurement-taking campaign is presented in the context of the Great Depression, which brought construction enterprises in the entire Poland to an almost total standstill and thus caused exceptional unemployment among architects, especially those of the younger generation. The Labour Fund was to help combat unemployment by initiating public works that supplied jobs to white-collar workers, architects and art historians among them. What is more, the aim of the Society’s campaign was to continue making the scholarly inventory initiated by state authorities; as a result, the entire action was carried out with direct support from the Central Bureau for Inventorying Artistic Monuments at the Ministry of Religious Denominations and Public Enlightenment. During the campaign, about a hundred architectural monuments were inventoried, located in a number of voivodships (including the Kielce, Warsaw, Silesia and Cracow ones); the collection of over 500 measurement photographs were ultimately transferred to the Central Bureau’s archive.

abstracts.content: Manufacturers estimate the specific compression levels of their products to satisfy the intended medical purposes. Medical compression bandages have different intended purposes. This means that the engineer must be able to estimate the clinical performance, referred to as the interface pressure, during product development and prior to clinical testing in humans. Unfortunately, the mathematical equations found in the literature do not result in interface pressure values that are similar to the ex vivo pressure. Therefore, the present work aims to demonstrate that the use of bandage elongation as a premise for predicting the interface pressure, as revealed new expression, can provide a reliable estimate.

abstracts.content: Wymaganie dot. kontrastu jest szczególnie ważne dla zapewnienie dostępności infrastruktury kolejowej dla osób z upośledzeniem wzroku. Ważność tego aspektu potwierdzono na podstawie przeglądu literatury w tym zakresie. Parametr kontrastu wg TSI PRM powinien być spełniony m.in. dla ścieżek prowadzących na peronach. Z doświadczeń w weryfikacji WE wynika, że wykazanie zgodności dla tego parametru na podstawie pomiarów wybudowanych peronów często nastręcza trudności. Celem pracy badawczej było określenie warunków dla przeprowadzenia weryfikacji WE w odniesieniu do kontrastu ścieżek prowadzących na peronach. W artykule omówiono metody wyznaczania wartości współczynnika odbicia światła (LRV) oraz metody obliczenia wskaźnika możliwe do zastosowania w pomiarach terenowych na peronach kolejowych. Wnioski zostały sformułowane na podstawie analizy danych uzyskanych z pomiarów na wybranych peronach linii kolejowej nr 351. W pracy omówiono wyniki uzyskanych pomiarów w oparciu o wzór obliczenia LRV wg Michelsona. Ponadto przedstawiono trzy główne aspekty wskazując na potrzebę określenia więcej niż jednego zestawu kolorów dla danej ścieżki prowadzącej na peronie, tj. kwestie percepcji koloru, niejednorodności próbek i stopnia degradacji. Na podstawie przeprowadzonej analizy sformułowano przede wszystkim rekomendację dla producentów materiałów nawierzchniowych, aby określali co najmniej zakres wartości LRV dla swoich materiałów. W odniesieniu do weryfikacji WE zaproponowano ocenę na podstawie wartości średnich LRV dla zidentyfikowanych kolorów ścieżki dotykowej i jej tła.

The contrast requirement is particularly important to ensure the accessibility of railway infrastructure for people with visual impairments. The importance of this aspect was confirmed based on a review of the literature in this area. According to TSI PRM, the contrast parameter should be met, among others, to guide paths on platforms. Experience in EC verification shows that demonstrating compliance for this parameter based on constructed platform measurements is often difficult. The research aimed to determine the conditions for carrying out EC verification concerning the contrast of guiding paths on platforms. The article discusses methods for determining the light reflectance value (LRV) and calculating the index for field measurements on railway platforms. The conclusions were formulated based on data analysis obtained from measurements on selected railway line No. 351 platforms. The paper discusses the results obtained from the measurements based on the LRV calculation formula according to Michelson. In addition, three main aspects are presented, indicating the need to specify more than one set of colors for a given guiding path on the platform, i.e., color perception, sample heterogeneity, and the degree of degradation. Based on the analysis, a recommendation was formulated for paving material producers to determine at least the range of LRV values for their materials. Regarding EC verification, an assessment was proposed based on the average LRV values for the guiding path's identified colors and background.

proceedings.title: ECAI 202528th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy – Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025)

abstracts.content: Purpose: The aim of this article is to indicate the role of artificial intelligence in local governments, mainly how smart technologies improve city management and communication with residents. Analyzing different applications of AI, it is emphasized how intelligent systems contribute to efficiency, transparency and responsiveness in local management. Need for the study: In the current reality, local governments need to manage resources more effectively, provide public services more efficiently and engage residents in decision-making processes. AI has become a key driver of innovation in smart city initiatives, but there is still a gap in understanding its real applications and impact and adapting it to the needs of residents. Methodology: This article is based on a review of secondary sources, including scientific literature and reports. It also indicates examples of cities that have successfully implemented AI. The study synthesizes the findings from these cases to identify challenges, benefits and barriers to implementing AI technologies. It also presents preliminary results from interviews with local government representatives. Findings: The article identifies key areas in which artificial intelligence has a significant impact on the activities of local governments. The results show that AI significantly improves city governance by optimizing resource allocation, improving public service delivery, and enabling proactive problem-solving. For example, AI-based predictive analytics or communication tools (e.g. chatbots). It also identifies challenges such as data privacy, ethical concerns, and technology readiness, which are key for local governments. Practical Implications: The article provides local governments with practical insights into the benefits and challenges of implementing AI technologies to help them make decisions. It also highlights the importance of developing ethical frameworks and inclusive policies to ensure that AI solutions benefit all citizens equally.

Measuring physical and chemical properties of single nanofibers for energy applications—possibilities and limits

abstracts.content: <jats:p>Nanofibers can be produced by various techniques, such as a broad range of electrospinning techniques to produce nanofiber mats from different polymers or polymer blends, often filled with metallic or semiconducting nanoparticles or by different nanotechnological bottom-up or top-down methods. They are important parts of a wide variety of energy applications, such as batteries, fuel cells, photovoltaics, or hydrogen storage materials. Usually, their physical or chemical parameters are measured by averaging over a fiber bundle or a part of a nanofiber mat. Here, we report the possibility of measuring the different physical and chemical properties of single nanofibers and nanowires. Such measurements of single nanofiber properties are more complicated than investigations of fiber bundles or whole nanofiber mats and, thus, are less often found in the literature. After a fast increase in such investigations between 2001 and 2009, the numbers of respective studies are now stagnating. This review thus aims to make the different possibilities more visible to a broader scientific audience by providing several examples based on atomic force microscopy (AFM) and other broadly available techniques. The focus of this review is on technologies that reveal more information than the pure surface morphology of nanofibers or nanowires, such as mechanical properties or wettability, porosity, or electrical conductivity.</jats:p>

abstracts.content: The subject of the article is a discussion of civil servant liability under the Law of September 16, 1982 on Civil Service Servants. The study presents the evolution of responsibility, the nature and prerequisites and principles of disciplinary responsibility, as well as the procedure of disciplinary proceedings against appointed public officials incurring disciplinary or order liability for violation of employee duties in a government office. The author proves on the basis of statistical surveys conducted in state offices, the regulations are not applied in practice. He makes a proposal to repeal the regulations in this regard in the future, or to extend disciplinary responsibility to any person employed in an office under the Labor Code and also proposes considering the creation of a unification in a single act of the principles of responsibility and uniform procedure of various categories of public officials.

results.title: Władza technologiczna i dostęp do informacji o jej sprawowaniu

abstracts.content: W pracy rozważam, w jaki sposób konstytucyjne prawo dostępu do informacji publicznej (art. 61 Konstytucji) prowadzi do konieczności transparentnego informowania o technologiach wspomagających władzę publiczną. Wyróżniam potrzebę unikania „instytucjonalnych czarnych skrzynek” - czyli zapewniania dostatecznej jawności informacji na temat wykorzystywanych technologii wspomagania władzy - oraz potrzebę unikania „algorytmicznych czarnych skrzynek” - objawiającą się w potrzebie preferowania takich algorytmów, na temat których dane mogą być rzeczywiście zrozumiałe dla obywateli. Zarazem charakteryzuję wymóg instytucjonalnej transparentności jako istotniejszy w tym sensie, że podlegający mniejszej liczbie wyjątków. Z kolei wymóg algorytmicznej transparentności zdaje się bardziej stopniowalny i zależny od pola zastosowania danej technologii. Zarazem wykorzystanie algorytmicznych czarnych skrzynek tworzy ryzyko fasadowego charakteru udostępniania informacji na temat takich nietransparentnych algorytmicznie technologii. Dlatego w tych dziedzinach działalności państwa, w których oczekiwany jest wysoki poziom przejrzystości dla obywateli, art. 61 Konstytucji zdaje się tworzyć po stronie władzy publicznej wymóg zarówno informowania o wykorzystywanych technologiach, jak i właściwego ich projektowania.

In this paper, I consider how the constitutional right of access to public information (Article 61 of the Polish Constitution) leads to the need for transparent information about technologies supporting public authority. I highlight the need to avoid ‘institutional black boxes’ - i.e. ensuring sufficient transparency of information on the technologies used to support public authorities - and the need to avoid ‘algorithmic black boxes’ - manifested in the need to prefer such algorithms that data about them can be truly understandable to the public. At the same time, I characterise the requirement for institutional transparency as more important in the sense that it is subject to fewer exceptions. The requirement for algorithmic transparency, in contrast, seems to be more gradable and dependent on the field of application of a given technology. However, the use of algorithmic black boxes creates the risk of a superficial nature of information disclosure about such algorithmically non-transparent technologies. Therefore, in those areas of state activity where a high level of transparency is expected for citizens, Article 61 of the Polish Constitution seems to create a requirement on the side of public authorities to both provide information about the technologies used and to design them appropriately.

results.title: A leader for difficult times : Russian domestic and international politics during the COVID-19 pandemic in the light of the 'Collective Programming of the Mind'

abstracts.content: The aim of this chapter is to complement the available research in the field of cultural linguistics with conclusions on the use of ‘cultural programming’ as a tool for exerting influence. The case study of Vladimir Putin as the leader of Russian society is the subject of analysis. Some elements of similarities in ‘cultural programming’ between Russia and Iran were taken into account as a premise for inferring the reasons for the success of the cooperation between the leaders of these countries. Hofstede’s Cultural Dimensions Theory was accepted as a theoretical frame, whereas the chosen methodology was relational analysis, supplemented with elements of conceptual analysis. A high degree of semantic implication of the highlighted concepts was assumed. Putin’s speeches addressed to Russian citizens are the first corpus of source materials. The researched period spans the years 2019–2021. The conclusions are that what emerges from the president’s speeches is an image of a united, proud Russian nation and its good leader. The accumulation of words bringing to mind associations with family creates the image of a leader-father. With his words, Putin creates the figure of a leader directing his people towards clearly defined goals, ensuring order and security. The same features of Putin’s portrait can be seen when he speaks about Iran in international fora.

Numerical Simulation of the Transition to Detonation in a Hydrogen–Air Mixture Due to Shock Wave Focusing on a 90-Degree Wedge

abstracts.content: This study numerically explores the initiation of detonation through shock wave reflection and focusing on a 90-degree wedge in varying mixtures of hydrogen–air. The simulations were conducted using the ddtFoam code, an integral part of the OpenFOAM open-source Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) package of density-based code for solving the unsteady, compressible Navier–Stokes equations. The simulation results unveil three potential outcomes in the corner post-reflection: deflagrative ignition in the corner, deflagrative ignition with intermediate transient phases leading to a delayed transition to detonation in the trailing combustion zone close to the apex of the wedge, and ignition with an immediate transition to detonation, resulting in the formation of a detonation wave in the corner tip. In the experimental investigation, the transition velocity for the stoichiometric mixture stood at approximately 719 m/s. In contrast, the numerical simulation indicated a transition velocity of 664 m/s for the same stoichiometric mixture, reflecting a 5.5% decrease in velocity. Such an underestimation level of 5–8% by the simulation results was observed for mixtures of 25–45% H2 in air.

results.title: Problematic consequences of personalisation of advertisement : the case of insurance contracts

abstracts.content: The personalization of advertisements has significant implications for consumer contracts, possibly leading to mismatched consumer expectations and by this causing consumers to enter into contracts with terms that are not properly adjusted to their situations, characteristics, and preferences. This issue is particularly problematic in consumer insurance contracts, where general private law and consumer law remedies, which are intended to shield consumers from the negative effects of personalization, often fail to adequately protect the interests of insurance clients. The reason for this is that these mechanisms tend to weaken contractual bonds, whereas from the perspective of the insurance client, contract adjustment would be a much more desirable solution. Therefore, this chapter investigates the possibilities of correcting irregularities in the content of insurance contracts caused by (mis)personalization. The analysis suggests that the standard of legitimate consumer expectations could serve as a critical tool for correcting the content of insurance contracts in such scenarios. This approach aims to align the content of insurance agreements with what consumers reasonably expect based on pre-contractual communications. The article concludes by advocating for the adoption of this standard to mitigate the adverse effects of personalization and ensure fairer outcomes in consumer insurance contracts.

results.title: Exploring the significance of Polish-Turkish economical relations in the period 1945-1952

abstracts.content: During the pivotal years following the Second World War (1945-1952), Polish-Turkish relations were important, particularly in the economic sphere. On 19 August 1945, the Turkish government’s recognition of the Provisional Government of National Unity (the communist government residing in Warsaw) marked a crucial shift. This move led to the cessation of the Türkiye’s recognition of the government-in-exile in London and the pre-war diplomats. During the period under review, trade between Poland and Türkiye began to resemble pre-war levels. However, this resurgence was not without its challenges. The primary obstacle was the unfamiliarity with each other’s markets and the need for caution, particularly on the Polish side. The Poles were eager to negotiate contracts to purchase copper from Türkiye, while the Turkish government were keen to sell tobacco and dried fruit to Poland. These negotiations were often arduous, but despite the difficulties, both sides typically managed to sign trade agreements. The talks for establishing direct air flys also proved a significant issue. This chapter aims to elaborate on Polish-Turkish relations between 1945 and 1952 and to answer some crucial questions. Why was there little trade between the two countries? Did both sides willing to improve the relations in this area? What impact did remaining on the two sides of the Iron Curtain have on mutual relations? These questions are not just academic inquiries, but they hold the key to understanding the dynamics of international relations during this crucial period.

results.title: Challenges for managers/HR regarding the perception of empowerment in organizations

abstracts.content: The research paper presents the results of a study that examines understanding of empowerment in management and demonstrates practices indicating the presence of empowerment in work teams among Polish students and working professionals. The paper contains both a theoretical section, which includes a critical analysis of the literature, and an empirical section. The research is based on a survey questionnaire originally designed by the researchers, with questions developed from a literature review. The study was conducted in 2024, and the questionnaire was administered to 213 working professionals and 245 students from Jagiellonian University specialising in discipline of management. The results of the study explore respondents' understanding of the concept of empowerment in the context of management. They also investigate practices that indicate the presence of empowerment in work teams among Polish students and working professionals. The analysis relies on respondents’ subjective declarations. Working professionals and students associated similar terms with the concept of empowerment. However, some differences emerge in understanding empowerment as giving employees the right to autonomy and control over their actions, fostering a workplace climate of trust, and creating an environment where employees feel secure, supported, and able to trust their managers. The survey results indicate that working professionals enjoy a higher level of autonomy in the workplace than students. Additional differences can be observed in the extend to which respondents have control over team activities, as well as in the availability of substantive support in solving problems and resolving issues within their teams. The paper uncovers new insights, providing a basis for developing a comprehensive tool to support further research in this field. Additionally, the findings offer practical value for managers in organisations and for university personnel responsible for designing and analysing teaching processes. Future research could involve a larger sample from various industries, and further in-depth qualitative research is also recommended.

results.title: The press market in Poland after 1989 : significant press segments

abstracts.content: As a result of political, economic, and social transformations, the Polish press market underwent a significant transformation after 1989. The collapse of the communist system paved the way for media pluralism and press freedom, enabling the emergence of new publications and the dynamic development of the newspaper and magazine market. Alongside privatisation processes and the increasing influence of private investors, the press market began to restructure itself, introducing new business models and adapting to global media trends. The development of the internet and digital media in subsequent decades further influenced the industry’s evolution, leading to challenges related to readers’ migration to online platforms, declining print circulation, and the necessity of adjusting offerings to meet changing audience needs. T his article analyses the evolution of the Polish press market after 1989, considering changes in ownership structures, media operations, and the impact of new technologies on the sector. Viewing the press as an integral part of Poland’s media system, the study employs a systemic analysis method, which facilitates the examination of the legal, institutional, and political context of press functioning. It focuses on the most significant typological groups – daily newspapers, opinion weeklies, and women’s magazines – while also addressing the challenges faced by press publishers in the context of consistently declining print sales.

proceedings.title: Information Processing and Management of Uncertainty in Knowledge-Based Systems: 19th International Conference, IPMU 2022, Milan, Italy, July 11–15, 2022, Proceedings, Part I

conferenceSeries.fullName: International Conference on Information Processing and Management of Uncertainty

abstracts.content: In recent academic studies, new ways of constructing fuzzy implication functions have been developed. One of the proposed constructions is a ternary polynomial one of the form IF(x,y):=F(x,y,I(x,y)), where F is a polynomial, and I is a fuzzy implication. In the particular case of quadratic polynomials, under additional conditions, construction preserves properties like the left neutrality principle, the law of contraposition, or the identity principle of the initial fuzzy implication I. In this paper, we looked at the preservation of the ordering property under such quadratic polynomial construction. Additionally, we took a look at the case of arbitrary degree polynomials and their preservation of boundary conditions of a fuzzy implication.
